title: RS485 module (MAX485), on the floor
summary: The JZK TTL-to-RS485 module has no mounting holes. On the floor it sits on a taped pedestal in an outline pocket with lead gaps at the bus end, the logic end and both long sides, and two lid pads press foam onto it. On a 5 × 3 carrier it is hooked instead of taped: two snap hooks over each long edge, so it clicks in and lifts out.
firstUsed: Controller project (2026): room receiver and rack-ends

views.label: In the pocket
views.caption: Bus end (A+, B−, earth) on the left, logic end (VCC, TXD, RXD, GND) on the right, each with a 10 wide lead gap. Drag the slider to lift the board out.

views.label: On a carrier
views.caption: The module on a 5 × 3 carrier (50 × 30): the same 2.5 pedestal with no tape, the end walls with their 10 wide lead gaps, no side walls, and two snap hooks over each long edge, each on a tongue of plate cut free by a U-slot. Drag the slider to push the board down: its edges ride the 45° lead-ins, the arms flex out and the hooks snap back over its top, 4.1 above the plate. To take it out, lift one end of the board: the two hooks there cam open on their 45° undersides and the board pivots out. Cut open from the side to see the hooks' profiles.

views.label: Lid hold-down
views.caption: Two pads under the lid, 6 inboard of each end, press 3 mm foam onto the board, squashed by 1.

views.label: Fit piece
views.caption: Four pockets with a bridge where the logic-end lid pad would be, marked 1 to 4 dots: foam squeezed 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0. The ends are open so the board slides in under the foam.

specs.title: The module (JZK)
specs.note: Variants: XY-017 (42.8 × 15.22 × 0.8) and the classic MAX485 module with a screw terminal (44 × 14).

specs.title: The holder
rows: 10 at the ends, 6 in the sides
specs.badgeNote: the foam squeeze is set by the fit piece

specs.title: The carrier
rows: 5 × 3 (50 × 30), solid plate, M2.5 at the four corners
the carrier standard: self-tap into Ø6 × 4 floor bosses (top 5.6 above the floor) or nut traps
four snap hooks, two per long edge at X = ±10, reach 0.7, 0.3 to the edge; the end walls stop it along the board
lift one end of the board: the hooks there cam open. tab = true puts a lip on the +Y hooks for a fingernail
specs.note: Why 5 × 3: the end walls need 46.2 along the board, and each hook with its relief slot needs 6.9 past the board's edge, 29.3 across. A 4 × 3 would cut the end walls; a 5 × 2 has no room for the slots. Every variant in the table comes out 5 × 3.
specs.badgeNote: hook reach and clearance are set by snap-hook's fit piece

checks: Slide the board in under the foam: can you, without forcing?
Does the foam hold it firmly, without bowing the board?
Give it a tug: does it stay put?
Does the foam spring back when you take the board out?
fit.print: Print base down, no supports, in the enclosure's material.
